title: Swarm: Consul + Nomad snapshot backup (round-trip verified)
description: Runs `nexus backup take swarm --tag verify`. Runs consul snapshot save + consul snapshot inspect (the round-trip verify) + consul kv export + nomad operator snapshot save on a manager, downloads them to the build host, best-effort copies the Portainer boltdb.

observe.what: destination dir on the build host with consul.snap + nomad.snap + consul-kv.json; consul snapshot inspect reported OK
restore is deliberately refused on the live cluster (would overwrite live KV/jobs)

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.BackupTakeAsync captures + round-trip-verifies the Consul/Nomad raft snapshots to a build-host file; BackupRestoreAsync refuses a live in-place restore (DR runbook on an isolated cluster).
